summary: Serverless architecture combining React Native (Expo) frontend and FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL hosted on Google Cloud Run (asia-south1). Estimated monthly infrastructure cost ranges from $40 to $150.

frontend.justification: Cross-platform architecture supporting Android, iOS, and Web from a unified TypeScript/JavaScript codebase with offline SQLite support.

alternatives.why_not: Team skills center on JavaScript/TypeScript rather than Dart.

tradeoffs: Native platform bridges required for specialized hardware integrations.

backend.justification: Asynchronous Python framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation and Pydantic validation; enables rapid MVP development.

alternatives.why_not: FastAPI is more lightweight, provides native async performance, and integrates better with mobile APIs.

tradeoffs: Requires explicit worker process management (Uvicorn / Gunicorn) for multi-core scaling.

database.justification: ACID-compliant relational database with JSONB support, indexing, and full text search; available as a managed service across all major clouds.

alternatives.why_not: Lacks native relational foreign key integrity and ACID guarantees needed for structured transactional data.

tradeoffs: Requires connection pooling (e.g. PgBouncer) under high concurrent connection spikes.

hosting.justification: Managed serverless container platform scaling to zero when idle; data center in Mumbai meets India data residency while staying well within the monthly budget.

alternatives.why_not: Fargate incurs fixed minimum compute costs without scale-to-zero, consuming more of a tight $100–$150 budget.

tradeoffs: Occasional 1–2 second cold starts on new container scaling instances.

supporting.justification: Durable, encrypted cloud object storage for user document and photo uploads with presigned URL access.

alternatives.why_not: Local container disks are ephemeral and lose user uploads on container restarts.

tradeoffs: Outbound internet data egress transfer costs.

supporting.justification: Authentication service resolving email_password requirements with secure token issuance.

alternatives.why_not: Rolling custom authentication risks token vulnerabilities and password hashing security flaws.

assumptions: Estimates based on published cloud pricing units and standard resource allocations.

warnings.message: Team possesses skills in python, but target platforms include mobile. The engine recommends React Native or Flutter, requiring team onboarding for UI development.
